antecedent.defect: All five v3 entry points require the exclusive_full1g path to be a regular JSON file containing active=false. The canonical managed lease schema has no active field, and ManagedExclusiveLease.release removes both the lease and acquisition lock. Therefore v3 rejects a live managed lease but also cannot execute after a clean managed release.

scientific_semantics_preserved: The v3 Mechanism IR, causal closure, generated arm set P/K/D/M/R/S, per-arm state access, byte-64 join, SAFE-MIX posterior isolation, and compiler transformations are byte-for-byte unchanged.
The retained v3 compiler, causal-closure verifier, lock formats, compilation formats, schemas, and negative semantic controls remain authoritative dependencies.
No new predictor, probability, coder, archive, package, memory, or score claim is introduced.

managed_lane_contract.occupied_state: either path exists or is a symlink, regardless of JSON content
acquisition: Validate every existing parent component without following symlinks.
Create the exact acquisition lock with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW and mode 0600.
Write and fsync a random 256-bit ownership token plus the current PID.
Recheck that the lease path is absent after lock acquisition; otherwise remove only the owned lock and fail closed.
Retain the descriptor, device, inode, and token until the wrapped operation has stopped.
release: Require the lock path to remain a single-link regular file with the acquired device and inode.
Require its complete bytes to equal the ownership payload.
Unlink only that exact owned lock and fsync the namespace directory.
Never create, replace, parse, signal through, or delete the lease JSON.
managed_lane_contract.failure_policy: Any missing parent, symlink, preexisting lease, preexisting lock, post-acquire lease appearance, lock identity drift, token drift, write/fsync failure, wrapped nonzero exit, or cleanup failure rejects without a positive final receipt.
